questions.question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. No M are N.

II. Some O are N.

**Conclusions:**

I. All O are M.

II. No N is M.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follows

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d6cfd494c5489848418ece0f93863289738d9eefe028583450e412e6afef95c0.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All O are M → Does not follow (As no M are N and some O are N. So it is possible but not definite.)

II. No N is M → Follow (As no M are N. As direct relation is given between M and N that M cannot be N, therefore it is true.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion II follows.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.

questions.question:

questions.solution:

questions.question: Eight friends A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are seated in a straight line and all of them are facing north, but not necessarily in the same order. B sits second to right of F. F sits at one of the extreme ends of the line. Only three people sit between B and E. C sits third to the left of D. Only two people sit between D and A. G is not an immediate neighbour of E. Who is sitting on the immediate left of B?
questions.solution:
**Given:** Eight friends A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are seated in a straight line and all of them are facing north.

1) F sits at one of the extreme ends of the line. 

2) B sits second to right of F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3169b9116b46c9eba99dd84e08aa7118728f03e0b607a20b9bd79573d29893fa.png] 

3) Only three people sit between B and E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a41465f6fb6c97606fae9f5c06cfe5f8b0ba256bb50d75a3fac33257f2b38282.png] 

4) C sits third to the left of D.

5) Only two people sit between D and A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/864ea9b290423c5909004a8d64394f93426b80241c417f4a8bf223211f28d91c.png] 

6) G is not an immediate neighbour of E.

Thus, after positioning G only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. H.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/abeafc0f7d326e4e05172b4b0a51403447e2e37ad370343eecaac3a4b3e0d87b.png] 

Thus, after according to the final arrangement C is sitting on the immediate left of B.

Hence, **"Option 3"** is the correct answer.

questions.question: Pointing towards a man in photo, Ram said. "He is the brother of my son's paternal grandfather". How man is related to Ram?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Given statement: Pointing towards a man in photo, Ram said. "He is the brother of my son's paternal grandfather".

As Ram's gender is not known yet, therefore there are two possible cases.

Case 1) If Ram is male.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/05533d3476322c17644376272c372a04a425614bd50eaef6f35d9f18ef6d02fd.png] 

Case 2) If Ram is female.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/310bf0fabd7bbdff6243a4f8efed40acf465e0a2f6f8f33b1ddf32aa3113059c.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/56d03c772155eaf03180a664ed5c97d05e3104f6d5cd6c4b8040779a7fb0b9ae.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/05533d3476322c17644376272c372a04a425614bd50eaef6f35d9f18ef6d02fd.png] 

So, the man can be Ram's either paternal uncle i.e. father's brother or husband's paternal uncle.

As out of all the options 'Father's brother' is given, therefore case is eliminated.

Thus, the man is Ram's father's brother.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2"
